UPDATE house_races SET 
  status = 'General',
  candidate1_name = 'Thurman Bartie',
  candidate1_party = 'D',
  candidate2_name = 'Randy Weber',
  candidate2_party = 'R',
  notes = 'Thurman Bartie (D) won the May 26 Democratic primary runoff over Richard Davis (51.9% vs 48.1%). Faces incumbent Randy Weber (R) in November. Rated Solid R.'
WHERE state_code = 'TX' AND district = 14;
